PROG1.title: Introduction to C++
PROG1.content:
C++ Basics

C++ is a general-purpose programming language[cite: 4]. The main() function serves as the absolute starting point of execution for every C++ program[cite: 1].

  • Input/Output: Uses cin for input and cout for output[cite: 4].
  • Variables: Named storage locations used to store and manipulate data[cite: 1].

PROG2.title: Basic Syntax and Control Structures
PROG2.content:
Control Structures

Control structures determine the order in which statements execute[cite: 5].

  • Sequence: Execute statements in order[cite: 5].
  • Selection: Choose between alternatives using if, else if, else, and switch[cite: 2, 5].
  • Repetition: Repeat statements using for, while, and do-while loops[cite: 2, 5].

PROG3.title: Functions
PROG3.content:
Modular Programming with Functions

Functions are reusable blocks of code written to perform a singular, specific task[cite: 1, 3].

  • Parameters & Arguments: Functions can declare parameters to receive external values, which are supplied as arguments when called[cite: 1].
  • Return Types: A function may return a value or use void[cite: 3].
  • Prototypes: Function prototypes declare functions before their definitions[cite: 3].
